-- True when a name is one plain file name: no path separators and not "..".
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post not out or name.split("/").len() == 1
  post not out or name != ".."
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  if name == "" or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

-- Reads one note from the confined fs. A missing or unreadable file gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("no-such-file-xyz") == ""
  fs.read(name) else ""

-- Counts the names that can be read from the notes directory.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if is_plain_name(name) and read_note(name) != ""
        n += 1
  n
